description: Answers common UK questions about alcohol-free drinks in general, with a named public source for every line (UK law, government guidance, the NHS, UK health charities, peer-reviewed studies or, for halal, published religious rulings; US labels use the US regulator, TTB; hangover uses the Irish health service, HSE). Topics: labels (what alcohol-free, 0.0%, de-alcoholised and 0.5% mean), units (how much alcohol is in 0.5%), everyday_foods (trace alcohol in juice and bread), driving, alcohol_testing (EtG tests for work, licences or recovery), pregnancy, breastfeeding, under_18, cutting_down, stopping_drinking, sleep, hydration, gout, diabetes, blood_pressure, liver, medication, halal, gluten_free, hangover, calories, price (why it is not cheaper; duty), how_made, dry_january, exercise, vegan, can_it_get_you_drunk, best_buy (which alcohol-free beer to buy; says IMPOSSIBREW publishes this guide), labels_abroad (US label rules). Not medical or legal advice; it says when 0.0% is the better choice.
name: alcohol_free_guide
